subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘time has come’ is coded as ‘et im ak’;

‘come with money’ is coded as ‘nd ak co’ and

‘money has power’ is coded as ‘fu et nd’.

(All the codes are two-letter codes only.)

How will ‘with power’ be coded in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb6c5af6d388b8d02db3bd4fac1ea4214412b167f514cb7839f5652551f5e065.png] 

∴ Here, 'with power' is coded as 'fu co'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"fu co".**
